body: Founder real-time: 'ok HTA7 this shit is hard' -> AskUserQuestion identified Enforcement squads specifically as the pain point -> 'can i please always respawn with wooden sword' -> 'all players' -> 'always'. EnforcementManager previously spawned plain vanilla Zombies (20 HP, 3 base attack damage stock stats) with zero explicit tuning -- a real unintentional difficulty spike, not a designed one. Added ENFORCEMENT_MAX_HEALTH=14/ENFORCEMENT_ATTACK_DAMAGE=2 via Attribute.MAX_HEALTH/Attribute.ATTACK_DAMAGE -- softened, not trivialized, still a real fight. New RespawnGearListener gives every player a wooden sword on every respawn if they don't already have one -- directly complements the Enforcement tuning since a death-to-Enforcement respawn (the exact scenario driving the complaint) no longer leaves the player barehanded. Built, deployed, systemctl --user restart clean, server.log confirms GTA7 enabled with no exceptions -- restarted while a real player (.GarbageMan4147) was already connected. GTA7 commit 526e085.
title: GTA7 difficulty fix: Enforcement squad stats tuned down + guaranteed wooden sword on respawn
